name: meilisearch
description: Runs the site's visitor search on a Meilisearch server (self-hosted or Meilisearch Cloud) instead of Tovu's built-in search. Ships the search provider itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how to connect it. Meilisearch receives PUBLIC content only: published, publicly visible titles, text and URLs. Members-only or otherwise restricted content is never sent to it and stays in Tovu's built-in search.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Powers your site's search with Meilisearch. Only public content is sent to it.
